svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Start from the lever hub that comes on the press's pinion shaft (36 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across, bored to the shaft, 28 mm in the model). Remove its lever.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the square end off a 1/2 in drive extension bar, 16 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld it to the hub's outer face, square and on the shaft's centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Let it cool slowly; check it runs true when the hub is on the shaft.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 6 mm through the hub and shaft together, 12 mm from the head's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side face, and fit a 6 mm roll pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the torque-limiting socket (set to 180 N m) pushes onto the square,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then the ratchet handle pushes onto the socket's drive; set the ratchet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so a pull toward you drives the ram down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 250 N pull turns the shaft with no slip at the pin; the socket

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clicks or slips at about a 400 N pull on the 450 mm handle.
